messages:
Priya: Quick Q2 planning thread — hosted API serve strategies. Need decisions by Thursday. High-level asks: embeddings cost reduction target, chat latency SLOs for short sequences, rerank launch criteria, and customer-driven realtime requirements. Also tradeoffs for private vs hosted.
Jordan: For embeddings cost, options = 8-bit quant + batched streaming + prefix cache. Ballpark current cost $0.0008/embedding; target is $0.0004–$0.0005 to hit customer TCO.
Alex: Agree on two-profile approach: compact (cheaper) vs accurate (higher quality). Auto-route by customer preference. We'll need eval sets to map quality delta.
Mia: On latency SLOs — 400ms p95 for <64 tokens is aggressive on CPU-only regions. We should define 'short' precisely and call out required infra (dedicated GPU / pinned instances) for guaranteed SLO. KV prefix cache will help for chat sessions.
Sam: Rerank launch criteria proposal: 1) NDCG@10 >= baseline + 0.10 on customer evals, 2) p95 end-to-end rerank latency <100ms, 3) fallback path to older model with graceful degradation. Also need throughput target (qps) for baseline load tests.
Priya: Rollout plan sketch: canary at 1% traffic for 48h, automated quality checks against gold prompts, compare cost delta, and auto-fallback if error rate >1% or quality drop >5% on key metrics.
Alex: API ergonomics idea — let customers specify per-route SLO hints (e.g., "latency:strict") so routing/runtime can prioritize. That will help cost accounting and routing.
Mia: Ops note — autoscaler warmup for dedicated pools causes initial latency spikes. Need burst capacity (prewarmed nodes) or fast-warm kernels. We'll add a stress test to the perf harness.
deploy-bot: CI: canary pipeline "serve-strat-q2" created. Tests queued: perf/harness, regressions/embeddings, rerank/eval. Link: https://ci.internal/reports/serve-strat-q2
Priya: Ownership: Jordan = embeddings cost + eval criteria, Mia = latency SLOs & ops, Sam = rerank metrics + rollout. I'll own the overall spec doc and PM sync. Draft acceptance criteria (quick):
```
- embeddings: cost <= $0.00045/embedding (24h avg); cosine agreement >= 0.985 vs FP16 baseline on anchor eval set
- chat: p95 latency < 400ms for seq_len<=64 at 95th arrival rate; streaming enabled; quality parity vs current model within delta thresholds
- rerank: NDCG@10 >= baseline + 0.10 on customer evals; p95 latency < 100ms; fallback to stable model on errors
```
Jordan: I'll draft embedding eval plan and cost models by EOD Tuesday. Will include quant/compaction experiments and per-tenant routing impact.
Mia: I'll coordinate with eng-infra for dedicated pool perf runs and add a warmup strategy to the spec. Also will capture the autoscale SLA implications for Dedicated vs Hosted.
Sam: Heads up — one enterprise asked for "search-rerank realtime" in private deployment. That likely needs hot-path CPU optimizations or colocated GPU; calling out as a special enterprise requirement.
Alex: Thumbs up on the plan. +1 to per-route SLOs. :thumbsup:
Priya: No objections so far. I'll put this on the PM sync agenda Wed morning and circulate the spec draft before then. Thanks everyone.
